avoid_for: Playful or warm consumer brands, information-dense SaaS dashboards, long-form reading surfaces, and any light-mode-only or single-accent-reliant context — the system needs both the dark-band oscillation and the one-warm-note restraint to work.
best_for: Luxury aviation / premium travel editorial landing pages and high-end service brands that want near-monochrome architectural confidence — a pale sky hero, a slab-serif wordmark at fuselage scale, and one clay feature card per page.
name: Hyer Aviation
palette_voice: Bright white parchment canvas (pale dawn-sky hero) against Deep Ink (#000d10) as the single structural color — primary text, filled buttons, icon strokes, and footer — with one warm Clay Ember (#bc7155) reserved for a single featured card per page so restraint, not warmth, is the point; Cool Ash (#8e8e95) recedes behind primary copy, Pebble (#d5d3d4) hairlines only at edges; no shadows, elevation via white → clay → dark-slate surface shifts.
signature_moves: 187px weight 700 display headline with -3.74px tracking — type set at near-architectural scale so headlines read as physical objects
Every button and nav item is a full 1000px pill while the featured clay card stays hard-edged 0px — the soft/hard tension defines the system
One Clay Ember (#bc7155) featured card per page — the single warm note in an austere monochrome field, single-use per viewport
Hero headlines end with a period ('Beyond Travel.') — the signature typographic stop
Alternating full-bleed white canvas and #0f0f1c/#151623 midnight bands for vertical oscillation, with 80px section gaps

source.shadow: none — elevation via surface color shifts (white → clay → dark slate)

tagline: Cockpit twilight over parchment. A pale dawn-sky meets a slab-serif logo the size of a fuselage, with one warm clay accent breaking the monochrome restraint.
typographic_voice: A single display sans (HelveticaNowDisplay, subst. Neue Haas Grotesk/Inter) carries everything: weight 700 at 131–187px with extreme tight tracking reads as cast metal and anchors hero sections, while weight 400 at 18px with 1.61 line-height is the most spacious text block in the system; weight 700 is non-negotiable from 23px up, body never below 18px, no light or thin weights anywhere.
